en: A famous dance instructor. He rarely takes the stage himself, but is known throughout the world for his ability to extract talent from those he teaches. He doesn't seek money or power, and only instructs those he sees potential in. He met Haruka while in Japan to prepare for a concert and agreed to train her.

A famous dance instructor. He rarely takes the stage himself, but is known throughout the world for his ability to extract talent from those he teaches. He doesn't seek money or power, and only instructs those he sees potential in. He met Haruka while in Japan to prepare for a concert and agreed to train her. After Park's death, when Haruka's debut is threatened by the interference of Ousaka Enterprises, he supports Yamaura in preparing for the concert.

T-Set's manager. As the new stars of Osaka Talent, the largest entertainment firm in Kansai, he is already promoting them aggressively at TV studios and building ties with producers to facilitate their debut. He resents Dyna Chair for its strong performance in the Princess League despite being an underdog, and mocks them at every opportunity.

T-Set's manager. As the new stars of Osaka Talent, he is already promoting them aggressively at TV studios and building ties with producers to facilitate their debut. He resents Dyna Chair for its strong performance in the Princess League despite being an underdog, and mocks them at every opportunity. He doesn't let up even after Park's death, goading Haruka into promising to join Osaka Talent if she loses to T-Set in the Princess League Finals.

A member of the T-Set idol group. Park was the one who discovered her and she signed with Dyna Chair first, but later moved to Osaka Talent after they had a falling out. She has won her way to the Princess League Finals with flawless performances, and her singing and dancing abilities far surpass Haruka. She believes in earning your place and looks down on Haruka because of her inexperience, leading to conflict between them.

A member of the T-Set idol group. Park was the one who discovered her and she signed with Dyna Chair first, but later moved to Osaka Talent after they had a falling out. She believes in earning your place and looked down on Haruka because of her inexperience, leading to conflict between them at times. However, she sees Haruka's talent through her Princess League performances and recognizes her as a rival.

A member of the T-Set idol group. Park was the one who discovered her and she signed with Dyna Chair first, but later moved to Osaka Talent with Mai after they had a falling out. In contrast with Mai's brash personality and chiseled features, she has a youthful face and a winsome nature that have won her many fans.

A member of the T-Set idol group. Park was the one who discovered her and she signed with Dyna Chair first, but later moved to Osaka Talent with Mai after they had a falling out. In contrast with Mai's brash personality and chiseled features, she has a youthful face and a winsome nature that have won her many fans. Like Mai, she didn't take to Haruka at first, but over the course of the Princess League she is forced to admit that Haruka is a strong competitor.

Runs Osaka Talent, the leading talent agency in Kansai. He was an action star in the U.S., but an injury forced him to retire. Despite being a prominent figure in entertainment, he has a charming, sincere personality and is trusted implicitly by those he has signed.

Runs Osaka Talent, the leading talent agency in Kansai. He was an action star in the U.S., but an injury forced him to retire. Despite being a prominent figure in entertainment, he has a charming, sincere personality and is trusted implicitly by those he has signed. He is also a yakuza who holds the posts of Omi Alliance chief of headquarters and chairman of Ousaka Enterprises. He admonishes Kanai for pursuing Majima ahead of the impending East-West war, but decides to go to Tokyo to position himself as successor to the seventh Omi chairman.
Captain of Ousaka Enterprises, which controls Sotenbori. He is as tough as his massive frame suggests, to the point where little fazes him. He launched an attack on Dyna Chair's office with Ogita.

Captain of Ousaka Enterprises, which controls Sotenbori. He is as tough as his massive frame suggests, to the point where little fazes him. After growing frustrated at Katsuya's indecisiveness as others vied for the Omi throne, he decided to go after Majima alone. His actions led to the death of Park and put Horie in the hospital, but he failed to produce results and incurred Katsuya's wrath. However, this seems to ignite Katsuya's ambitions and they end up heading to Tokyo together.

A detective with the organized crime unit of the Osaka Prefectural Police. He is trying to stop the impending war between the Omi and the Tojo Clan without involving the Tokyo Metropolitan Police. He meets Kiryu in Fukuoka and Saejima in Sapporo, and persuades them both to go to Tokyo. In Osaka, he meets Akiyama of Sky Finance and tells him that Ousaka Enterprises is involved, but warns him to stay out of it.

Akiyama's secretary at Sky Finance. She handles the day-to-day running of the company for Akiyama, who is lax with appointments and generally disorganized. She loves Kanrai's grade-A kalbi with a passion. Though she left Sky Finance for a while, she later returned, thinking Akiyama would run it into the ground alone.

Akiyama's secretary at Sky Finance. She handles the day-to-day running of the company for Akiyama, who is lax with appointments and generally disorganized. She loves Kanrai's grade-A kalbi with a passion. Though she left Sky Finance for a while, she later returned, thinking Akiyama would run it into the ground alone. She was shocked at the news of Park's death, but is unhappy that Akiyama is neglecting his work to investigate.

A batter for the Nagoya Wyverns fifteen years ago. Now he ekes out a living as a nightlife journalist in Kineicho. He is terrible with money and has taken out a number of loans. Most of his paychecks go toward paying them back, leaving him with little to live on.

A batter for the Nagoya Wyverns fifteen years ago. After hitting a home run in his first game, he was permanently banned on suspicion of involvement in a baseball gambling scandal. Since then he's lived as a nightlife journalist in Kineicho. At Daigo's urging, he began digging into the incident that got him banned fifteen years ago. He discovered Fujita was behind it and decided to go with Daigo to Tokyo. Before that, he faced off with Sawada, who was also linked to the Nagoya Family.

A moneylender in Kineicho involved with Shinada since he came to town a year ago. A typical loan shark, he lends at high interest and is rumored to be connected to yakuza. He has a reputation for being ruthless when collecting on loans.

A moneylender in Kineicho involved with Shinada since he came there a year ago. A typical loan shark, he lends at high interest and is rumored to be connected to yakuza. He has a reputation for being ruthless when collecting on loans. But it turned out he was just using the rumors to scare clients, and has no yakuza ties at all. He caught the ball Shinada hit fifteen years ago and has been looking out for him since meeting him again. He helped Shinada learn the truth behind the baseball gambling scandal, and had his loan repaid through the reward from Daigo.

An acupuncturist in Kineicho and an old acquaintance of Shinada. Though he despairs at Shinada's constant pleas for money, he values the erotic massage parlor info that Shinada provides, so can't bring himself to sever ties.

An acupuncturist in Kineicho and an old friend of Shinada. Though he despairs at Shinada's constant pleas for money, he values the erotic massage parlor info that Shinada provides, so can't bring himself to sever ties. He used to be the Wyverns' massage therapist, but got fired after getting too close to the truth behind the baseball gambling. As he was helping Shinada look into the past and clear his debt through Daigo, he was badly wounded by the Nagoya Family, who feared their secret getting out.

An erotic masseuse at Club Futo Momo in Kineicho. She has kept her looks even after fifteen years of working in the adult entertainment industry, and is still a favorite of many customers. Shinada is one of them, and he writes articles about her frequently.

An erotic masseuse at Club Futo Momo in Kineicho. She has kept her looks even after fifteen years of working in the adult entertainment industry, and is still a favorite of many. Shinada is one of them, and he writes articles about her frequently. She is actually a member of the Nagoya Family and lured Shinada into a trap when he closed in on the truth. But personal feelings got in the way, and Takasugi helped him escape. She and Ushijima convinced the other members to turn themselves in, but they were all freed immediately.

Owner of a dining bar in Kineicho. Like other Nagoya establishments, he provides breakfast for the price of a cup of coffee, so the cash-strapped Shinada is a frequent customer. He also runs a tab for Shinada, who is often penniless after being shaken down by debt collectors.

Owner of a dining bar in Kineicho. Like other Nagoya establishments, he provides breakfast for the price of a cup of coffee, so the cash-strapped Shinada is a frequent customer. He also runs a tab for Shinada, who is often penniless after being shaken down by debt collectors. He is head of the Kineicho Chamber of Commerce and also a member of the Nagoya Family. He warned Shinada when he got too close and tried to silence him when he didn't listen, but Takasugi saved the day. He and Milky convinced the others to surrender, but they were freed.

A man who asked Shinada to look into a baseball gambling scandal that happened fifteen years ago. He offers twenty million yen as a reward. He seems to know of Shinada's past, and had the home run ball that Shinada hit in his possession. He hides his identity behind a mask.

Current chairman of the Tojo Clan, the largest yakuza group in Kanto. While in Hakata to prepare for war with the Omi, he caught wind of Aoyama's betrayal and went underground to find out who was masterminding things. He came to Kineicho and approached Shinada anonymously, asking him to uncover the truth behind the baseball gambling scandal. After learning that Fujita was leading the Nagoya Family, he revealed his identity to Shinada and told him not to get any more involved. However, after they fight, he agrees to take Shinada to Tokyo.

Current chairman of the Tojo Clan, the largest yakuza group in Kanto. While in Hakata to prepare for war with the Omi, he caught wind of Aoyama's betrayal and went underground to find out who was masterminding things. He came to Kineicho and approached Shinada anonymously, asking him to uncover the truth behind the baseball gambling scandal. After learning that Fujita was leading the Nagoya Family, he revealed his identity and they decided to go to Tokyo. Daigo goes on ahead, as Shinada seeks a final showdown with Sawada.

Manager of the Nagoya Wyverns when Shinada got caught up in a gambling scandal fifteen years ago. He resigned after the incident and has been out of baseball ever since, but it has now been announced he will be the new manager of the Tokyo Gigants.

Manager of the Nagoya Wyverns when Shinada got caught up in a gambling scandal fifteen years ago. He resigned after the incident and has been out of baseball ever since, but was recently announced to be the new manager for the Tokyo Gigants. He planned the gambling incident with the Kuroha Family fifteen years ago, to expel the Tojo Clan and Omi Alliance from Nagoya. He later formed the Nagoya Family with locals who wanted to protect the peace in Nagoya. When Shinada started to catch on, Fujita ordered Ushijima and the others to silence him, but they failed.
An ace pitcher for the Tokyo Gigants, with 197 wins to his name. He faced off with the rookie Shinada fifteen years ago, who hit his seventh pitch⑬a 151 km/h fastball⑬into the stands.
